scope: Rookies won in the FA Auction could only be offered an Extension, never a 1/2/3-year auction contract. The eligibility test excluded any status containing the word rookie, which caught Rookie-FAA — an auction win. Canon line 394 puts every auction win, FA or Expired Rookie, at 1, 2, or 3 years. Eight players across five teams were affected; the clause now defers to the rookie-OPTION path instead of matching on the word.
